missing.detail: rejection / reclaim candle in your direction

alternative.note: Tape favors LONG — the short trigger has no turn confirmation yet.

market.label: tape-neutral
market.note: Tape neutral — indexes range-bound. Leaders: XLE, XLV, XLP.

vol.note: Market vol calm (VIXY 16.7, 4th pct) — stops can tighten.

cycle.note: Institutional flow day (Tue/Thu rebalance & hedging) — entries tend to fill on real volume.

ladder.scale_out: Take 50% @ T1 → stop to breakeven → run 50% to T2

duration.valid_until: expected ~5 days, valid up to ~12 days

time_stop.note: If neither stop nor target fills within ~12 days, the thesis has expired — exit at market.

entries.label: Now · market
entries.plain: Take it now at market — fastest fill, but the worst price of the three. Price is already extended from value (high chase).

decision.reason: Short Mean Reversion into a strong bullish tape (100.0); higher-TF bullish with no turn confirmation. Knife-catch — stand aside; the long is the tape-aligned trade.
